Dear applicant,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin. We are pleased to hear that our programme meets your requirements.

Regarding the application deadline, The regular application period for Summer Semester 27 has closed. The next regular application period is for Winter Semester 27/28, from 1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027 [Doc 1].

As for the required documents, you will need to submit a copy of your degree certificate [Doc 2], a copy of your grade transcript [Doc 2], and proof of English language proficiency [Doc 2]. Additionally, if you are from China, Vietnam, or India, please also submit a certificate from the academic test centre (APS) [Doc 2].

The language of instruction for our programme is English, as stated on our official degree index page [Doc 3].

Regarding the study format, according to our official degree index page [Doc 4], the Project Management and Data Science programme is classified as a full-time Präsenzstudium (presence study).

We encourage you to review our programme's details and requirements on our website. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Sehr geehrte/r Bewerber/in,

vielen Dank für Ihr Interesse an unserem Master-Studiengang Project Management und Data Science (MPMD) an der HTW Berlin! Wir freuen uns, dass Sie sich für unser Programm entschieden haben.

Zunächst möchten wir Ihnen mitteilen, dass die nächste Antragsfrist für den Wintersemester 27/28 am 1. November 2026 beginnt und bis zum 28. Februar 2027 andauert. Die genauen Termine finden Sie auf unserer Website unter [https://mpmd.htw-berlin.de/applying](https://mpmd.htw-berlin.de/applying) [Doc 1].

Um sich für unser Programm anzumelden, benötigen wir einige Dokumente. Bitte beachten Sie die folgenden Anforderungen:

* Ein Kopie Ihres Abschlusszeugnisses
* Eine Kopie Ihres Notenverlaufs (falls nicht auf Englisch oder Deutsch)
* Eine Erklärung des Notensystems an Ihrer vorherigen Universität (falls nicht bereits im Notenverlauf erklärt)
* Beweis für mindestens ein Jahr Berufserfahrung in jedem Bereich nach Ihrem ersten Hochschulabschluss
* Offizielle Bestätigung von Arbeitgebern, die den Zeitraum der Beschäftigung belegen
* Wenn Sie selbstständig sind, können Sie Verträge und/oder Steuerbescheinigungen einreichen
* Beweis für Englischsprachigkeit (z.B. TOEFL, IELTS, PTE Academic Test oder vergleichbare Prüfungen)
* Kopie Ihres Passes oder Personalausweises
* Lebenslauf (résumé)
* Zeugnis der akademischen und/oder beruflichen Referenz
* Link zu einem Motivationstext oder Brief der Motivation

Bitte beachten Sie, dass alle Dokumente in Englisch oder Deutsch eingereicht werden müssen. Wenn Ihre Dokumente nicht auf Englisch oder Deutsch sind, benötigen wir auch eine Übersetzung.

Wir hoffen, dass diese Informationen hilfreich für Sie waren. Wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder Hilfe bei der Anmeldung benötigen, stehe ich Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Studierendenservice der HTW Berlin

results.staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you have taken to review our programme catalogue and we are happy to provide more information on the English language requirements.

According to our programme catalogue, the official language of instruction is English [Doc 1]. For the Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science, applicants must demonstrate proficiency in English at level C1 or higher. The accepted proof for this requirement includes TOEFL with a score of 95+ points (internet-based test), IELTS with a score of 7.0+, PTE Academic Test with a score of 76+, or comparable tests giving CEFR level C1 [Doc 1]. Additionally, proof of study in a university-level programme conducted in English for at least one year, or graduation with a complete English-language degree, will also be recognised as Level C1.

Please note that if the official language in your country of origin is English, you may not need to provide proof of English language skills. However, we recommend checking our programme catalogue and the official sources for the most up-to-date information on this requirement.

After the initial selection process, we make further efforts to admit a balance of genders, nationalities, etc. to ensure a diverse cohort.

If you have any further questions or concerns regarding the application process, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in International Business at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you have taken to review our programme and we are happy to assist with any questions or concerns you may have.

Regarding your query about applying before graduation, according to [Doc 1], applicants can apply for a Master's study programme via the application portal of HTW Berlin if they are currently in the final semester of their Bachelor's degree programme and have already registered to write their final thesis. However, please note that you must prove that you have successfully completed your Bachelor's study programme by the deadline specified in [Doc 1], which is 20 January for winter semester start or 20 June for summer semester start.

Regarding English language requirements, as stated on our official programme page [Doc 2], applicants who are not from an OECD country must provide proof of English language proficiency. The required test scores are TOEFL with at least 95 points for the internet-based test, IELTS with a minimum score of 7.0, or PTE Academic Test with a score of at least 76 points.

Regarding application fees, according to [Doc 3], there is no additional proof of English language required for applicants who obtained their qualification from an English-speaking OECD country applying for the Master's degree programme International Business. However, if you are not from an OECD country, you will need to submit your application via uni-assist and pay the processing costs.

Please note that our Master's programme in International Business has a limited capacity of 40 students per year, as stated on [Doc 4]. We try to maintain small class sizes to ensure excellence in teaching.

We would like to remind you that the online application process via uni-assist is mandatory for international applicants. You can find more information about the application process and deadlines on our website [Doc 5].

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. We are happy to assist you with your application.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

response.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in International Business at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you have taken to review our programme and we are happy to assist with any questions or concerns you may have.

Regarding your query about applying before graduation, according to [Doc 1], applicants can apply for a Master's study programme via the application portal of HTW Berlin if they are currently in the final semester of their Bachelor's degree programme and have already registered to write their final thesis. However, please note that you must prove that you have successfully completed your Bachelor's study programme by the deadline specified in [Doc 1], which is 20 January for winter semester start or 20 June for summer semester start.

Regarding English language requirements, as stated on our official programme page [Doc 2], applicants who are not from an OECD country must provide proof of English language proficiency. The required test scores are TOEFL with at least 95 points for the internet-based test, IELTS with a minimum score of 7.0, or PTE Academic Test with a score of at least 76 points.

Regarding application fees, according to [Doc 3], there is no additional proof of English language required for applicants who obtained their qualification from an English-speaking OECD country applying for the Master's degree programme International Business. However, if you are not from an OECD country, you will need to submit your application via uni-assist and pay the processing costs.

Please note that our Master's programme in International Business has a limited capacity of 40 students per year, as stated on [Doc 4]. We try to maintain small class sizes to ensure excellence in teaching.

We would like to remind you that the online application process via uni-assist is mandatory for international applicants. You can find more information about the application process and deadlines on our website [Doc 5].

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. We are happy to assist you with your application.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Reference links for staff verification:
- [Doc 1] Master’s study programmes: https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-the-application-portal-of-htw-berlin/masters-study-programmes/
- [Doc 2] Application: https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/master/for-applicants/application
- [Doc 3] Proof of English proficiency: https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-uni-assist/proof-of-english-proficiency/
- [Doc 4] FAQ: https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/master/faq
- [Doc 5] Application via uni-assist: https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-uni-assist/
